compilerOptions.target: Write the output in modern JavaScript
compilerOptions.module: Use the modern Node.js module system (ES Modules)
compilerOptions.outDir: Put the compiled JavaScript in a 'dist' folder
compilerOptions.rootDir: Only look for code in the 'src' folder
compilerOptions.strict: Be super strict about types (catches the most bugs)
compilerOptions.esModuleInterop: Allows us to use 'import express from

include: Only compile files inside the src folder
